gen-audiowide-gf-pt-serif-caption: PT Serif Caption stands tall and a touch heavier in its stems than its hairlines. And Audiowide keeps to a drafting-pen outline of constant width, drawing the eye, where the text serif does the quiet work of carrying words.
gen-audiowide-gf-suez-one: Tiled, techy letters up top, drawn with one constant rolling-ball line. But Suez One underneath is bookish, with big open e and a shapes that keep a long run of text inviting.
gen-audiowide-lora: Lora reads with a broad, welcoming c and gentle pencil-soft thinning at the curves, easy company for the eye. Audiowide's inked thread above only makes that softness feel warmer.
gen-audiowide-merriweather: Audiowide draws round letters like bent wire, spaced out like tiles with wide grout lines. Merriweather then settles in with a stocky, tall-bodied line and a soft swell, cozy across a long passage.
gen-black-ops-one-author: Glyphs that look cut from strips of equal width, with c openings as narrow as a pencil-lead channel, lead the way. Author follows with a calm swell on its bowls, made for brief reading.
gen-black-ops-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Black Ops One is closed and tight, drawn with technical-pen steadiness and tiny sidebearings. BhuTuka Expanded One does the opposite job, its curvy open serif letters slowing the pace to a leisurely walk.
gen-black-ops-one-gf-hepta-slab: Tight, closed, stencil-sharp headings meet stretched-out slab words. But Hepta Slab lets its open counters breathe into the white space, so a long passage unspools slowly and without thick-thin fuss.
gen-black-ops-one-gf-kiwi-maru: Narrow openings and a technical-pen steadiness mark Black Ops One. Kiwi Maru's strongest quality is its generosity: open terminals that stop far from the stem and a ringlike o with a constant wall.
gen-black-ops-one-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart from the next, open counters leading outward like pipe cleaners. But Black Ops One, closed and technical-pen steady, is the firm counterweight that makes that openness stand out.
gen-bungee-inline-author: Bungee Inline spaces its decorative, retro glyphs far apart, like beads on a long cord, with a low, inlined look. Author follows with a quiet contrast between strokes, made for short stretches of reading.
